records.statement: The first 372-check candidate validator run rejected five untouched inherited v642-v4 tools because it compared LF Git blobs with CRLF Windows worktree bytes without newline normalization.
records.recovery: Compare LF-normalized content, keep the inherited Git blobs untouched, rerun the complete validator, and retain this failed attempt after recovery.

records.statement: The combined command that created two fresh detached evidence worktrees exceeded its orchestration timeout after both worktrees had registered at the exact evidence head; a residual Git process ended normally before validation began.
records.recovery: Audit both registered worktrees and the residual process read-only, preserve both additive snapshots, require exact detached heads and clean status, then validate each snapshot separately and retain this timeout after recovery.
